name: Req2Test · Requirements to Jira stories, QA tickets and Excel test script

parameters.content:
## Requirements → Jira → Test script
Upload an **FSD or Change Request** (Word or PDF), add **wireframes** (images, PDF or a Figma link), or type **existing Jira story keys**.

1. Claude breaks the document into **user stories with acceptance criteria** (and writes criteria the document lacks)
2. New stories are **created in Jira**. Existing ones are read, **never recreated**
3. Claude writes the **test cases** per story, checked by a quality gate
4. A **QA ticket** per story is created in Jira and **linked** to the story
5. You download the **Excel test script** (Summary + one sheet per section)

Edit **Settings** first. Choose *No* for "Create Jira tickets" to try it without Jira.

### 1. Read & analyse
The **test-script service** turns Word/PDF/images/Figma into content Claude can read. Claude (as a business analyst) returns stories, criteria marked *document* or *generated*, and open questions.

### 2. Jira stories
Stories from an earlier run of the same document are found by their label and **reused**. Claude matches re-worded stories to the earlier ones. Typed keys are **read**, not recreated. Jira errors are recorded, not fatal.

### 3. Test cases & QA tickets
One Claude call per story (in parallel). Test ids run across the whole script (e.g. SL-001…). A story that already has a linked *QA:* ticket gets a comment instead of a second ticket.
